key.name: input-paths
key.summary: Comma-separated list of input device paths
key.description: Comma-separated string of /dev/input/event* device paths to monitor and redirect events from.

key.name: display
key.description: If non-empty, this value will be set as the DISPLAY environment variable before initializing libxdo. If empty, the existing DISPLAY in the environment is used.

key.name: enable-wayland
key.description: If true, input-redirector will use the Wayland backend (virtual input injection). If false, it will use the X11 backend (libxdo).

key.name: wayland-display
key.description: The Wayland display socket name to use (e.g. wayland-0, wayland-1). This will be applied to the WAYLAND_DISPLAY environment variable when the Wayland backend is enabled.
